name: SFU Grad Map
tagline: An interactive graph of a university's course prerequisites, built from messy catalogue text.

awards: Best Use of SFU Courses API

problem: The university's course system makes prerequisite chains hard to follow, the team says.
solution: Gemini turns unstructured prerequisite text from the courses API into JSON, shown as a D3 graph with descriptions and equivalents.
demo_moment: Team-described: search a course and hover its prerequisites.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of SFU Courses API” among 217 submissions.
Uses the LLM only to structure data for a visual.

lessons: Fix a local system everyone complains about and the judges are your users.
